jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager (Reporting and Analytics)
jobs.location: New York, NY | Austin, TX | King of Prussia, PA | Scottsdale, AZ
jobs.description:
Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. The New York City-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States.

Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace-delivered retirement plans, employer-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities.

Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit  vestwell.com

Who Are We Looking For?
Vestwell's marketing team is looking for a Senior Marketing Operations Manager to serve as the primary owner of marketing analytics and reporting. This person will partner with Data, Product, and Revenue Technology to understand the data available across Google Analytics, HubSpot, and Salesforce, bring those sources into a consistent reporting view, and build the dashboards marketing needs to measure performance and make better decisions.

The role will also own marketing attributes, the data points used to identify meaningful customer groups and support targeted campaigns. Working closely with Product and Engineering, this person will understand how attributes are defined and used, represent Marketing when attributes change, and help campaign teams apply them effectively.

This is a hands-on analytics and reporting role, not a software or data engineering position. Success requires strong data judgment, practical reporting and dashboard-building skills, a clear understanding of how business systems connect, and the ability to translate stakeholder needs into useful reporting.

What Will You Be Doing?

- Own marketing analytics and reporting. Serve as the main point of contact for marketing performance data, dashboards, recurring reporting, and measurement questions. Establish clear metric definitions and reporting standards so teams use a consistent view of performance.

- Understand and connect the data. Partner with Data and Revenue Technology to map the available pre and post-sale data across Google Analytics, HubSpot, and Salesforce. Determine how those sources should work together, identify access or quality gaps, and create a reliable reporting view of the customer journey.

- Build dashboards and recurring reports. Translate marketing questions into practical dashboards and reports that track initiatives, campaign performance, funnel movement, and business outcomes. Maintain the reports, validate the underlying data, and improve them as needs change.

- Own marketing attributes. Maintain Marketing's understanding of the customer attributes used for segmentation and targeting. Partner with Product to understand how an attribute is defined, where it comes from, and how it can be used. Act as Marketing's point of contact when Product or Engineering proposes a new attribute or a change to an existing one.

- Enable targeted campaigns. Help marketing teams identify useful customer groupings and apply approved attributes to campaign design, audience selection, personalization, and performance analysis. Confirm that segments are based on reliable data and can be measured consistently.

- Measure the marketing funnel. Connect upper-funnel activity and pre-sale engagement to lead progression, sales outcomes, and relevant post-sale signals. Develop campaign and funnel reporting while clearly documenting data and attribution limitations.

- Coordinate across teams. Work comfortably with Marketing, Data, Revenue Technology, Product, and Engineering to define requirements, resolve data questions, prioritize work, and communicate findings in terms each team can use.

Requirements
The Necessities

- 5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing operations, business intelligence, or a similar data-focused role.

- Advanced hands-on experience with Google Analytics and HubSpot reporting, including the ability to build, validate, and explain reports within each platform.

- Working knowledge of Salesforce reporting and data structures, with the ability to partner with Revenue Technology to obtain and apply the data Marketing needs.

- Experience building dashboards and reporting frameworks in a business intelligence or data visualization tool such as Tableau, Sigma, or Looker.

- Experience reconciling data from multiple systems, documenting metric definitions, identifying data-quality issues, and explaining the limits of the available data.

- Experience using customer attributes, segments, or product data to support targeted marketing campaigns and measurement.

- Strong analytical judgment and the ability to translate business questions into clear data requirements, useful reports, and actionable findings.

- Demonstrated ability to work across Marketing, Data, Revenue Technology, Product, and Engineering teams, including stakeholders with different technical backgrounds.

- Strong project management and communication skills, with close attention to accuracy, consistency, and follow-through.

- Bachelor's degree in marketing, analytics, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

The Extras

- Experience in financial services, technology, or another regulated industry.

- Relevant Google Analytics, HubSpot, Salesforce, or business intelligence certifications.

- Familiarity with product or behavioral analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Pendo.

- Basic familiarity with SQL, data warehouses, or data integration concepts. This knowledge is helpful for partnering with technical teams but is not an engineering requirement.

This role will be based in either the New York City, Austin, King of Prussia, or Scottsdale office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in-office operation.

The expected base salary range for this position is $105K - $140K base. This position is eligible to participate in the Company Bonus Pool and is eligible to receive new hire equity in the Company. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired.
Employee Benefits
We’re an innovative, high-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility while providing access to our collaborative offices in Midtown Manhattan, Austin, King of Prussia, and Scottsdale. And, of course, as a company focused on helping people save for the future, we offer a competitive 401(k) plan.

Interview Process
Our interview process starts the same for every candidate with 1-2 introductory conversations to learn more about your background, interests, and what you're looking for, while also giving you the opportunity to learn more about Vestwell and the team. From there, the process varies by role but typically includes a skills or experience-based assessment, such as a coding interview, portfolio review, or deeper discussion of your relevant experience. Successful candidates then move on to a virtual or in-person interview panel. Before extending an offer, we complete a reference check with a current or former manager and a peer. Throughout the process, we prioritize transparency, clear communication, and minimizing surprises.

For your awareness you will only receive correspondence from recruiting@vestwell.com any other domain not ending in  vestwell.com  is not our Recruitment team.

Vestwell’s  Privacy Policy.  Attention California residents: In the course of conducting our business and complying with federal, state, and local government regulations governing such matters as employment, tax, insurance, etc., we must collect Personal Information from you. jobs.description:

The New York City-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Who Are We Looking For?

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Compliance Director of Trust Company and Custody Operations to lead and manage regulatory compliance and operational oversight across our trust company, custodial, and trading operations. This individual will play a key role in ensuring compliance with all applicable regulations related to 401(k) plans, ERISA, and trust and custody services. The ideal candidate will bring a deep understanding of regulatory requirements, operational excellence, and a proven track record in managing regulatory operations within financial services or trust company and retirement plan administration.

What Will You Be Doing?

- Lead the regulatory operations function with a focus on qualified retirement plans , particularly 401(k) plans, IRAs, and Emergency Savings Accounts.

- Create and implement procedures and internal controls for all trading activities within our custodial operations and proactively monitor our teams and systems for compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

- Ensure compliance with ERISA , Internal Revenue Code (IRC) , DOL , IRS , trust company regulations, and SEC regulations.

- Oversee and enhance controls related to trust and custody operations, as well as state savings programs , ensuring alignment with fiduciary standards and regulatory expectations.

- Provide regular reporting to internal stakeholders and Risk Committee about material risks, incidents, and the effectiveness of risk mitigation strategies.

- Partner with internal stakeholders (legal, compliance, product, operations) to interpret new and existing regulations and apply them to business practices.

- Monitor regulatory developments and proactively advise senior leadership on potential business impacts and required changes.

- Serve as the lead for  the Legal Team to lead the Vestwell Trust Company SOC 1 audit and New Hampshire Banking Department regulatory exam.

- Liaise with external auditors, regulatory agencies, and third-party service providers during examinations, audits, inquiries, or other matters as needed.

- Oversee and support regulatory reporting and filings (e.g., Form 5500, IRS/DOL disclosures).

- Manage a team of regulatory operations professionals, providing leadership, coaching, and performance oversight.

- Drive continuous improvement and automation of regulatory and compliance processes and controls.

Requirements

The Necessities

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field required; advanced degree or professional certification (e.g., JD, CPA, CRSP, QKA, CISP) preferred.

- Minimum of 10+ years of experience with a proven track record in regulatory compliance or operations in the retirement, trust, or custodial services industry.

- Deep knowledge of ERISA, 401(k) regulations, trust company laws, custody services, and applicable IRS/DOL regulations.

- Experience managing operational risk, compliance audits, and regulatory examinations.

- Strong leadership and team management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across functions.

- Exceptional organizational, analytical, and communication skills.

- Experience working with recordkeeping platforms, trust accounting systems, or custodial platforms is a plus.

The Extras

- Start up experience

Who Are We Looking For?

We are seeking a Internal Sales Director who will serve as a strategic consultant and trusted advisor to financial advisors and internal stakeholders. In this role, your primary responsibility is to analyze advisor needs, provide tailored guidance, and influence outcomes through consultative engagement. As a result, you will own and manage a full sales cycle within a defined territory in order to promote Vestwell’s growth in the financial advisor marketplace.

You will partner closely with Regional Vice Presidents, Marketing, Product, Operations, and Partner Success teams to support advisor relationships, optimize processes, and ensure that Vestwell’s offerings align with client objectives. This position requires independent judgment, strategic thinking, and the ability to translate insights into actionable recommendations that strengthen advisor partnerships and drive long-term growth.

What Will You Be Doing?

You will be the primary driver for converting both organic and sourced leads into plan sales within your assigned region. Beyond this baseline, you will be expected to:

- Serve as a trusted advisor to financial advisors, providing guidance on plan design, fiduciary considerations, and platform capabilities.

- Conduct needs assessments and strategic discussions to align Vestwell’s solutions with client and advisor objectives.

- Consulting with prospects about possible plan features or plan types that may align with their workforce and assessing whether a standalone plan or aggregated plan would work best for the prospect's demographics and business goals.

- Develop and maintain repeatable regional relationships, supporting long-term engagement and partnership success.

- Initiate and own a consistent lead prospecting practice, managing lead-to-contact conversion and strategically prioritizing opportunities to maximize pipeline growth.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with financial advisor prospects to create repeatable regional partnerships and long-term engagement.

- Manage a robust pipeline of advisor opportunities, ensuring accurate tracking and reporting while applying discretion and judgment to guide prioritization.

- Convert plan opportunities into closed-won sales through a repeatable, scalable process, applying the MEDDPICC sales methodology with discretion and judgment.

- Own accountability for achieving KPIs month-over-month, including meeting quota, conversion targets, and other performance metrics.
Collaborate strategically with Regional Vice Presidents to support repeat advisors, small market solutions, and other territory-specific initiatives.

- Provide proactive support to the regional RVP on prospecting, opportunity prioritization, and strategic sales initiatives.

Requirements

The Necessities

- 3+ years of experience in a client-facing, consultative role within Financial Services, FinTech, payroll, or a similar industry.

- Proven ability to manage complex relationships and provide strategic guidance throughout multi-step business processes.

- Ability to carry a plan sale over the entire sales cycle from prospecting to conversion

- Demonstrated success in achieving sales goals (Rep of the year, Quota club, etc.)

- Strong attention to detail and a passion for creating a top-notch selling environment and process.

- A hunter with a proven track record of forecasting, and executing new sales through a repeatable and scalable sales process and pipeline.

- Self-starter who can operate well in a collaborative team environment.

- Good knowledge of Salesforce, comfort level with other Sales technology

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills are a must.

- Proven ability to prioritize multiple projects and tasks, adapt to changing needs, and tackle new challenges daily!

The Extras:

- Experience in a startup or high-growth company.

- Understanding of the defined contribution or workplace retirement plan ecosystem.

Who Are We Looking For?

Vestwell is looking for a dedicated and self-motivated Senior People (HR) Business Partner, G&A, to join our People Team. We are building a team of world-class talent and are looking for an organizational powerhouse who can collaborate with multiple internal teams and stakeholders. You will manage our full employee life cycle, including onboarding and internal operations. As the People Business Partner for the G&A Organization, which consists of Service & Delivery, Finance, and Legal & Compliance, you will have a front-row seat and a direct impact on the next phase of our growth. The People Business Partner will be responsible for managing the successful partnership and collaboration of the Operations Teams and the People Team. Our ideal candidate is passionate about innovation, embodies our Vestwell Core Values, and takes initiative to ensure the wellbeing and growth of our employees.

What Will You Be Doing?

Day-to-day, you will be expected to:

- Serve as a strategic People Partner to leaders and employees within the G&A organization, acting as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for people-related matters.

- Exercise independent judgment in managing and advising on the full employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, performance management, compensation and benefits administration, and workforce planning.

- Serve as a trusted change partner to G&A leaders, helping teams navigate organizational shifts through thoughtful communication, stakeholder alignment, and effective change-management strategies.

- Lead and facilitate on-site and hybrid onboarding experiences, lunch-and-learns, and engagement sessions to support employee integration, learning, and connection.

- Ensure ongoing compliance with local, state, and federal employment laws and regulations, applying policy interpretation and judgment to real-world employee scenarios.

- Actively support and help evolve Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) and other inclusion-focused frameworks that strengthen belonging and engagement across the organization.

- Lead employee relations efforts, including conducting investigations, internal audits, and disciplinary meetings, and advising leaders on appropriate, compliant courses of action.

- Assess team capabilities and performance trends to identify development needs, succession considerations, and opportunities for upskilling.

- Partner with Learning & Development to design and deliver targeted training programs and workshops aligned to the unique needs of the G&A organization.

- Remain deeply embedded in the business by attending and leading regular stakeholder meetings, serving as the “eyes and ears” of the organization and surfacing insights that inform leadership decisions.

- Collaborate closely with technical leadership to understand workforce dynamics, team health, and organizational design considerations.

- Partner with Recruiting to forecast hiring needs, support resourcing strategies, and provide insight into workforce changes to enable proactive talent planning.

- Lead the annual Summer Internship Program, including program design, execution, and evaluation, with a focus on talent development and full-time conversion opportunities.

Requirements

The Necessities:

- 3-5 years of Human Resources / People Operations experience, preferably at a high-growth tech company/start-up

- Experience building, maintaining, and presenting HR data analytics

- High emotional and social intelligence with experience fostering positive, strong relationships with diverse groups of people

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills that demonstrate a high level of professionalism

- Highly organized and detail-oriented; you can handle multiple projects and dynamic priorities without missing a beat

- Experience managing projects independently end-to-end, bringing relevant stakeholders in to contribute where necessary

- Passionate about people and how they function together to create a valuable organization

- Required to be in-office 4 days per week in Vestwell’s King of Prussia office

The Extras

- Experience working in a high-paced startup environment or SaaS environment

- Prior experience using Rippling

- Experience supporting a hybrid team
